mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 50 degrees with clear skies at Verona Area High School, a full moon overhead, and an air quality index of 52.

The City of Verona has announced that a segment of Hwy M near the new Aldi will close from October 5 to October 7 for asphalt work, and Fall Leaf Collection also begins on October 5 with loose leaves requested behind the curb.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, with additional yoga and trivia events occurring early next week.
In a noteworthy call from September 10, officers responded to a burglary at Hunters Cove Way where they apprehended an offender after a firearm was discharged.
Culver's of Verona is serving up OREO REESE'S Cheesecake today and will be opening its doors at 10:00 AM.
